name: Spicy Creole Chicken, Pork Sausage & Rice Jambalaya with RO-TEL

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, measure spices into a medium bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp garlic powder
2 ½ tsp paprika
2 tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp basil, dried
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 sticks celery
3 yellow bell peppers
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery; trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add both to the bowl with the spices.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Add half of the green onions and parsley to the bowl with the spices, celery, and pepper. (Place remaining green onions and parsley in a small bowl and set aside for garnish.)

Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, medium dice chicken. Add chicken and additional salt to the pot with the veggies and continue to cook, stirring often, until chicken starts to brown, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato paste to the pot and stir to combine.
Add rice, RO-TEL, and broth to the pot; stir to combine the jambalaya and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 (284 ml) cans RO-TEL diced tomatoes & green chilies
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the jambalaya is heating, using a clean cutting board, slice the cooked sausages into thin rounds; add to the pot.

Once boiling, stir the jambalaya, cover, and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 18-20 minutes. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide jambalaya between bowls; garnish with reserved green onions and parsley. Enjoy!
